name: Enhanced Monitoring & Investigation
description: Keep systems online, raise logging verbosity, open an investigation and hunt for related activity. Lowest disruption, highest residual risk.

actions.description: Open an investigation case and assign an analyst
Enable verbose process, PowerShell and network logging
Hunt for the incident's indicators across the estate

name: Credential Containment
description: Reset passwords, revoke sessions and tokens and temporarily disable compromised accounts. Stops credential-based spread with limited host downtime.

actions.description: Force password reset for affected accounts
Revoke active sessions, Kerberos tickets and refresh tokens
Temporarily disable affected accounts pending investigation
Require MFA re-registration for affected accounts

name: Endpoint Isolation
description: Network-isolate affected hosts through EDR while preserving forensic state. Strong containment of host-based threats at the cost of host downtime.

actions.description: Network-isolate affected hosts via EDR (management channel retained)
Capture memory and triage artefacts before remediation
Block identified malicious binaries/hashes estate-wide

name: Network Segmentation & Egress Control
description: Block malicious external infrastructure and restrict traffic between zones around the affected segment, limiting lateral movement and C2 without taking hosts offline.

actions.description: Block external IPs/domains linked to the incident at the perimeter
Apply temporary deny rules between the affected zone and critical zones
Enable full network flow logging for the segment

name: Ransomware Emergency Containment
description: Isolate affected hosts, segment the network, disable involved accounts and protect backup infrastructure. Maximum containment, maximum disruption.

actions.description: Network-isolate affected hosts immediately
Segment the affected zone from servers and backups
Disable accounts involved in the incident
Take backup repositories read-only/offline and verify integrity
Notify incident commander, legal and executive stakeholders

name: Web Application Containment
description: Block attacking sources at the WAF, apply virtual patching and, if needed, take the vulnerable application offline for patching.

actions.description: Block attacking source IPs at the WAF/perimeter
Deploy WAF rule to block the exploited request pattern
Schedule emergency patching of the vulnerable application

name: Data Exfiltration Response
description: Stop data leaving the organisation: block destinations, revoke cloud tokens, preserve evidence and start breach assessment.

actions.description: Block exfiltration destinations at proxy and firewall
Revoke cloud/API tokens for involved accounts
Preserve logs and transfer records for breach assessment
Engage privacy/legal for breach notification assessment
